result.instructions: ACOS exposes an agent-oriented Android verification API. Start with acos_help for the workflow and acos_capabilities for what is implemented. The core loop is inspect -> verify -> read the verdict -> fix -> rerun. `unsupported` means the engine cannot do it: never rewrite the app to hide it, never call it a pass. `fail` means the app ran and a check did not hold: read the assertion diff. Tool results are the ACOS JSON envelope; `isError` is true whenever status != pass.
